action.prompt: A spec task finished. Did it produce a NEW durable fact, such as a decision, a failure plus its fix, a business rule, tech debt, a new component, or a convention? If not, do nothing and output nothing. If so, add one line per fact ('[YYYY-MM-DD] fact | source | how to apply') to the matching .kiro/memory/*.md file. If an existing line is outdated, edit it instead of adding a duplicate. Promote a fact to 04-project-memory.md only if it is critical, and keep that file under 120 lines. Mark the task [x] in tasks.md only if its tests passed. Output at most 1 line.
